items.body: قاد هاري كين، منتخب بلاده الإنجليزي، إلى الفوز على كرواتيا بنتيجة 2-1 في ملعب ويمبلي، مساء الخميس، ضمن منافسات دوري الأمم الأوروبية. وكان مهاجم بايرن ميونخ، الذي حظي بتكريم قبل انطلاق المباراة، عقب تتويجه بالكرة الذهبية، قد سجل هدف الانتصار من ركلة جزاء، ليُبقي آمال منتخب الأسود الثلاثة، قائمة، في إنهاء دور المجموعات متصدرًا، حال فوزه على إسبانيا في الجولة الأخيرة، الأحد المقبل، على ملعب ميتروبوليتانو. وعقب المواجهة أمام المنتخب الكرواتي، تحدث كين إلى وسائل الإعلام، ووجه رسالة تحمل طابع التحدي إلى المنتخب الإسباني، الذي يقوده المدرب لويس دي لا فوينتي، والذي أنجز مهمته هو الآخر، بالفوز على جمهورية التشيك (2-0). ونشرت صحيفة سبورت ، تصريحات هاري كين، حيث قال "بالتأكيد، هدفنا هو إنهاء المجموعة في الصدارة". وتابع "بعد المباراة الأولى، عندما خسرنا أمامهم هنا، كنا نعلم أننا قادرون على تقديم أداء أفضل بكثير. قلنا لأنفسنا: سنفوز بجميع المباريات حتى المواجهة المقبلة، ثم سنرى ما سيحدث. والآن، يوم الأحد، لدينا الفرصة المثالية لإثبات ما نحن قادرون على تحقيقه". وأعرب قائد المنتخب الإنجليزي أيضًا، عن امتنانه للتكريم الذي حظي به قبل انطلاق المباراة، قائلًا "كان الاستقبال في بداية المباراة، لفتة رائعة ومذهلة. وبمجرد أن تبدأ الكرة في الدوران، يصبح الأمر الأهم هو تحقيق الفوز وحصد النقاط الثلاث". ولف…

items.body: تنفس لويس دي لا فوينتي الصعداء أخيراً، فبعد أسبوع من التقارير الطبية والشكوك والجدل، أكد مدرب المنتخب الإسباني أن لامين يامال جاهز لمواجهة إنجلترا، وأن نجم برشلونة سيكون حاضراً في المباراة الحاسمة التي ستحدد متصدر المجموعة. وأوضح دي لا فوينتي، خلال تصريحات صحفية بعد الفوز على التشيك 2-0 نقلتها " سبورت "، أن يامال يشعر بتحسن كبير وسينضم إلى زملائه غداً، كما يشعر ميكيل أويارزابال بتحسن وسينضم إلى الفريق. وعن المباراة، قال: كما توقعنا، واجهنا فريقاً هجومياً استغل تفوقه البدني ومهاراته في الكرات الثابتة، مما خلق ضغطاً على دفاعنا، أهدرنا فرصاً لا نضيعها عادةً، استغلوا نقاط ضعفنا قرب منطقة جزائهم لشن هجمات مرتدة، لو استغللنا بعض فرصنا، لكانت الأمور أكثر هدوءاً.. لم نهدأ إلا بعد أن أصبحت النتيجة 2-0". وبخصوص الحالة البدنية، أكد المدرب الإسباني: لدينا أخبار سارة، لامين يامال في حالة ممتازة ويتوق للانضمام إلى المعسكر غداً، ميكيل كذلك سيصل أحدهما ظهراً والآخر بعد ذلك بقليل، لكن كلاهما سيكون معنا غداً". وبخصوص مواجهة إنجلترا، أوضح دي لا فوينتي: "بالنظر إلى مستوى الفريقين، توقعنا أن تكون المباراة بمثابة نهائي كأس العالم أو بطولة أوروبا. أيٌّ من الفريقين قادر على الفوز، إنها فرصة لمشاهدة اثنين من أفضل فرق العالم، نريد مواصلة هذا الزخم وهذه السلسلة من الانتصارات". وسيتدرب لامين وأويارزابال مع ب…

items.title: Jensen Huang leaving Nvidia is not a good thing for PC gaming, and I’ll tell you why
items.summary: We PC gamers are far from the belle of the AI ball.
items.body: Jensen Huang has resigned from his position as Nvidia CEO . That's such an odd sentence to write, as a huge part of my career as a tech journalist has revolved around covering Nvidia, its graphics cards, and its leather-jacketed chief. As I write this article, I'm already seeing reactions on social media from PC gamers. Some are shocked, some are indifferent, and some appear to be celebrating. In terms of the latter, I'd imagine that's because the ex-Nvidia boss has become one of the most recognisable figures behind the great AI revolution, which, err, isn't popular within our hobby, to say the least. items.body: A little less than two weeks after their multiplayer features were taken offline because of a mysterious " server issue ," multiplayer functionality in Dark Souls 2 and Dark Souls 3 has been restored, meaning invasions and messages are once again working as they should. Word of the service restoration game via a very businesslike message on the Dark Souls website: "Regarding the temporary suspension of the game server for Dark Souls 2 and Dark Souls 3, the investigation has been completed and the fix has been applied. The game server and online features are now restored. "We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused, and thank you for your patience and understanding." So what exactly went wrong? Well, that's the mysterious part. Aside from intermittent apologies for the inconvenience and thanks for your patience in messages posted to X, FromSoft's had nothing to say about it—and that remains the case now: It's back, be happy, speak of the matter no more. Whatever happened, it clearly wasn't as serious a problem as the 2022 mess that saw PC servers for all Dark Souls games shut down for the better part of a year . items.title: Antec C6 Curve Air review
items.summary: A chassis that ticks all the right boxes at just the right price.
items.body: Shangri-la, the promised land. Aside from the very notion of that concept being oh so appetising in the chaotic world that is 2026, there's something of that in the C6 Curve Air. An odd way to start a chassis review, I'll admit, particularly one that genuinely, I think is probably one of the best PC cases of 2026, but it's more than a metaphor here. This feels like something a little special this case. It feels like how Corsair's 4000D series felt, or NZXT's H7 lineup when that first debuted, or even Phanteks' Evolv arsenal from way back when at the start of my tech journalism career. There's something iconic here, that I can't quite place my finger on, something that I think is massively underrated in the world of custom rigs. Refined subtlety. Honestly the C6 Curve Air feels as if it's some bastard love child of the Phanteks Evolv series, Asus's Pro Art line and Fractal Design's North variants. Born in secret, and somehow less than $100. It's clean, modest, with an elegant aesthetic, good choice of materials, dependable internal layout, decent cable management, and it's genuinely a chassis that I can't stop looking at. items.title: Kioxia has chained together 640 SSDs to create a 157 *petabyte* storage solution, because AI data centers get all the cool toys
items.summary: Got any spare gigabytes, guv?
items.body: There's a golden rule of storage: no matter how much you have, it's never quite enough. Nevertheless, Kioxia is taking that principle to its limits, as it's announced " a new storage density milestone " in the form of 640 of its 245.76 TB enterprise SSDs chained together to create just over 157 petabytes worth of storage in a single rack cabinet. 157 petabytes is... well, it's 157 million gigabytes. Enough storage space for God of War: Ragnarok, a 190 GB game , to be installed over 820,000 times. And yes, it's been designed for AI data centers. The "storage solution" (I do hate that term) has been created in collaboration with Dell, and essentially amounts to 16 PowerEdge R7725xd servers , each stuffed with 40 Kioxia LC9 Series drives inside one industry-standard 42U server rack . "As AI workloads drive continued growth in unstructured data, organizations need storage that can deliver higher capacity without a corresponding increase in data center floor/rack space, power consumption or cooling requirements," says the press gumph. items.title: Final Fantasy 14 players are gathering in virtual vigils to honour the passing of the game's most prestigious bass player
items.summary: The Primals' Eikichi Iwai has died at the age of 57.
items.body: Final Fantasy 14 players have been gathering en masse across servers today in the wake of the news that Eikichi Iwai—the bassist behind the game's band The Primals—has passed away at the age of 57. A post went out on The Lodestone in the early hours of this morning (November 11) which read: "Thank you very much for your continued support of The Primals. As announced earlier today, we are deeply saddened to share the news of the sudden passing of bassist Eikichi Iwai. (Image credit: Square Enix) "Having witnessed his truly unforgettable performance on stage at the recent Final Fantasy 14 Fan Festival in Japan, the sudden news of his passing has come as a profound shock. The members of The Primals and the entire FF14 Development and Operations teams are overcome with deep sorrow. "As we reflect on all that Eikichi-san has left behind, our thoughts are with him, and we offer our heartfelt condolences." The Primals is Final Fantasy 14's in-house band, fronted by composer Masayoshi Soken and localisation lead Michael-Christopher Koji Fox, and accompanied by Tetsuya Tachibana, GUNN, and Iwai himself. items.title: No more need to slap 'reddit' on the end of your Google searches as Reddit Reviews is here to amalgamate everyone's thoughts
items.summary: Prepare for the review bombing.
items.body: I'm no stranger to slapping "Reddit" on the end of a Google search about a product to see what the unwashed masses (myself included) think about it. Assuming we're not reading bot comments, it's a great way to get a feel for a product you've not tested yourself. That's traditionally involved trawling various threads yourself, but now 'Reddit Reviews' is launching , which will collect user opinions on products and use them to inform dedicated reviews for them on Reddit's site. "Today, we are starting to test Reddit Reviews, a new experience that organizes product conversations from across Reddit into dedicated reviews and highlights the most important takeaways from across our communities. With Reddit Reviews, people can now more easily understand what a product is really like and feel confident deciding whether it’s right for them." AI is involved, of course: "Reddit Reviews uses AI to both organize these conversations where people describe their product experiences, and to surface the nuance, context, and connection to the original conversation." items.title: Sudokoo SK700V review
items.summary: If all air towers were built like this, I'd probably never use an AIO.
items.body: Where do I even begin with this thing? I'm so conflicted on the SK700V. It's such a unique problem, simultaneously excellent, and yet surprisingly frustrating to talk about. I'll start with the positive. It's exceptional. For the price, the display, the cooling, the installation process, it's next level, and I've never seen anything like it. It's honestly impressive. Without a doubt, the best air cooler I've tested in years. But, even with that glowing accolade there, boy does it irritate me. Let's talk features first, though, before I start to wail on the minor inconveniences that have upset my tech media brain, because the SK700V has one pretty nifty detail straddling its heatpipes, and that's namely, a full-fat display gracefully sitting atop that shiny tower. Yep, it's a screen we've finally got them folks, air towers with screens on them. And if Computex is anything to go by this year, we're going to be seeing a lot more screens on things. Graphics cards, CPU towers, heck, I'd be surprised if we don't see them on DRAM soon. That'll bring the price down, I'm sure of it. items.title: Overwatch is adding 6v6 role queue to its Competitive play: 'We've realised that there doesn't have to be a winner between 5v5 and 6v6'
items.summary: This town is big enough for the both of us.
items.body: If you had told me back in 2019 that I'd actually prefer a 5v5 version of Overwatch instead of the traditional 6v6 in the big old year of 2026 I'd have replied: "I'm still playing Overwatch in 2026?" Regardless, it's a strange revelation for sure (the 5v5 preference, not that I'm still playing Overwatch), but as time has gone on more players have discovered a similar love for the slightly more simplistic mode. While I prefer 5v5 for its more focused fights, emphasis on individual plays, and overall less cluttered nonsense I do also still enjoy playing a game of 6v6 every now and then. The only issue is that for the longest time the only version available in quickplay and competitive was the 6v6 open queue. This option may offer faster queue times, but with that often brings absolutely zero team cohesion. (Image credit: Blizzard Entertainment) But teams of four supports and two DPS may be a thing of the past now that Team 4 is trialling a 6v6 role queue for competitive.
